notes: Ludum Dare 49 game velho by JereNurminen (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/49/velho; https://jnur.itch.io/velho). Complete Unity 2020.3.25f1 project with playable Title, Game, and Congratulations scenes in EditorBuildSettings. GPL-3.0 at the repo-root LICENSE (standard GNU GPLv3 text). The author states everything was made by them in the 72-hour jam (Aseprite graphics, Bfxr sounds). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json: 2D animation/pixel-perfect/psdimporter/sprite/spriteshape/tilemap plus com.unity.2d.tilemap.extras 1.8.1-preview, Input System 1.2.0, Recorder 2.5.7, URP 10.7.0, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6 as a package not vendored into Assets, Timeline 1.4.8, uGUI, IDE packages, test framework, collab-proxy, and built-in modules. No bundled fonts, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~3.0M src snapshot.
